extraction_notes: Forward and reverse curves were digitized from the supplied vector plots without adding interpolated points; the grouped curves explicitly include DSK36.
Fig. 3 DSK35-DSK36 curve is a typical forward curve at Tj=25 degC, pulse width=300 us, and 1% duty cycle; its y-axis is logarithmic and its plotted current is instantaneous forward current.

Fig. 4 dashed DSK36-DSK320 curves show instantaneous reverse-current magnitude versus percent of rated peak reverse voltage at Tj=25 degC, Tj=75 degC, and Tj=100 degC; plotted reverse-current polarity is represented as positive magnitude.

The electrical-characteristics table gives DSK36 maximum instantaneous forward voltage 0.70 V at IF=3.0 A and maximum DC reverse current IR1 0.2 mA at VR=VDC=60 V and TA=25 degC. Typical junction capacitance is 160 pF at 4.0 V DC and 1 MHz.
Absolute-rating bounds for DSK36 are VRRM=60 V, VRMS=42 V, VDC=60 V, IF(AV)=3.0 A, and IFSM=80 A at TA=25 degC; these are limits, not fitted curve points. Source: p. 1 maximum ratings.
The datasheet publishes no reverse-recovery-time specification and no breakdown-voltage or breakdown-current specification; VRRM/VDC ratings are not treated as breakdown data.
